# FUSED ID

> Managed Cloud Colleagues

FUSED sets up and manages AI colleagues that learn a business, keep their knowledge current and help its team get work done. Ask it about products, processes and confirmed decisions through Outlook and Teams. Answers, research and ongoing learning about its role are part of the starting service. FUSED manages setup, ongoing learning and support. Additional skills are optional and quoted separately.

A colleague researches the business and its market within agreed access, asks questions when something is unclear and remembers confirmed guidance. It can suggest useful skills. The business chooses what work it may do and which results need approval. Learning more does not grant permission to do more.

## Service and examples

- [Home](https://www.fusedid.com/): Fuse your business with AI.
- [Our service and fees](https://www.fusedid.com/what-we-do.html): Initial setup, ongoing managed service and separately scoped skills. Fees are agreed in a proposal.
- [How it works](https://www.fusedid.com/how-it-works.html): Define a role, introduce the colleague and use it for business questions as it builds understanding. Add skills as needed.
- [Skills](https://www.fusedid.com/capabilities.html): Enquiries, marketing, sales research, administration, quality improvement, recruitment support and business knowledge. Illustrative workflows show the work, outputs and human decisions.
- [Your existing tools](https://www.fusedid.com/existing-tools.html): Outlook, Teams and other suitable business systems, with access and connections agreed for the role.
- [Examples and experience](https://www.fusedid.com/examples.html): NOVA’s illustrative profile and separate accounts from businesses the founders have operated in. These are not FUSED client case studies.
- [Quality and continuous improvement](https://www.fusedid.com/quality-example.html): Applied experience with investigation and action ownership.
- [Prospecting and lead intelligence](https://www.fusedid.com/prospecting-example.html): Applied experience with repeatable sales research.
- [Talent screening](https://www.fusedid.com/recruitment-example.html): Applied experience with evidence and human hiring decisions.
- [Meet NOVA](https://www.fusedid.com/nova.html): An illustrative AI colleague profile with an example working style and conversation; not a real person or client result.

## People and quality

- [Our team](https://www.fusedid.com/about.html): Wayne, James and Simon bring business, technology and engineering experience.
- [Why FUSED](https://www.fusedid.com/why-fused.html): Business understanding, practical engineering and ongoing management.
- [Quality and control](https://www.fusedid.com/quality-and-governance.html): Knowledge ownership, approvals, review and earned responsibility.
- [AI and ISO 9001](https://www.fusedid.com/ai-quality-systems-iso9001.html): Current knowledge, controlled procedure updates and continual improvement. Certification is not required to use FUSED. FUSED does not provide ISO certification.

## Get started

- [Talk to FUSED](https://www.fusedid.com/contact.html): Discuss a role or part of your business that needs help.
- [Design a role](https://www.fusedid.com/role-brief.html): A private worksheet that does not submit information to FUSED.
- [Privacy](https://www.fusedid.com/privacy.html): Website information handling and engagement-specific arrangements.

FUSED ID Pty Ltd is based in Melbourne, Australia. Contact: sales@fusedid.com.
